about.text: I've always loved creating. First with shapes, volumes, and light. Then with lines of code.

After a degree in visual communication and several years as a CAD designer and 3D artist, I chose to follow another passion: technology. In 2025, I joined an intensive bootcamp at La Capsule to become a Full-Stack developer, before pursuing a Master's in Information Systems Architecture at Epitech.
Today, alongside my master's degree, I work as an apprentice at Swiss Life as a ServiceNow Developer. I design and optimize internal tools to streamline processes.
In parallel, I run LEO Design 3D, a 3D modeling business dedicated to architects: photorealistic renders, immersive visualizations, and accurate project projections.
This dual perspective as both developer and visual creator allows me to approach each project with the same standards: designing solutions that are precise, aesthetic, and sustainable.
Curious about new technologies (VR, AR), I continuously explore the bridges between these two worlds. Because ultimately, coding or modeling is always the same thing: bringing an idea to life.
PS: I've even started coding my own VR game! 🎮

items.title: Master's in Information Systems Architecture
items.subtitle: Cloud, Cybersecurity, AI Track
items.description: Information systems architect program. Apprenticeship-based training focused on software engineering, project management, and holistic understanding of application architectures.

items.title: Full-Stack Web & Mobile Developer
items.description: 10-week intensive bootcamp. JavaScript stack: React, React Native, Node.js, Express, MongoDB. Agile methodologies (Scrum), Clean Code, TDD, and version control with Git/GitHub.

items.title: Technical Degree in Industrial Product Design
items.description: Apprenticeship-based training focused on mechanical and industrial design. Proficiency in CAD software (SolidWorks, AutoCAD, SketchUp) and project management from bid to construction site.

items.title: Technical Degree in Visual Communication
items.subtitle: Multimedia Track
items.school: Lycée Saint Vincent de Paul — Loos
items.description: Graphic design and digital creation. Proficiency in Adobe Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Flash). Introduction to coding via ActionScript and web interface design.

projects.title: Hexavax
projects.subtitle: Vaccine demand prediction platform
projects.short_description: Presented at the French Presidential Office — Data & Machine Learning for public health.
projects.description: I contributed to the development of Hexavax, a decision-support platform for the government and pharmacists to anticipate vaccine needs. The tool features a vaccination campaign dashboard, a multi-level interactive map (regions, departments, overseas territories), a time slider to visualize past trends and future predictions, and 6 analysis layers: viral spread, hospital saturation, vaccination centers, vulnerable populations, storage areas, and expenses.

projects.title: JambonBeurre
projects.subtitle: Mobile app to share meals with others
projects.short_description: Never eat alone again — Find a meal companion in just a few taps.
projects.description: Final project at La Capsule bootcamp, developed with a team of 5. JambonBeurre helps find meal companions to avoid eating alone. Designed for students, employees, or travelers, the app focuses on simplicity, user experience, and real-time interaction.

projects.title: KeepGoals
projects.subtitle: Financial goals tracking web app
projects.short_description: Visualize your progress towards financial goals in real-time.
projects.description: Fullstack application to track personal financial goals and make life projects a reality. Home purchase, travel, or any other project: KeepGoals lets you define goals, log contributions, and visualize progress through an intuitive dashboard.

projects.title: Toothy
projects.subtitle: Gamified tooth brushing tracker app
projects.short_description: Turn tooth brushing into a game — Points, stats and rewards.
projects.description: Gamified mobile app to encourage good dental hygiene, with a young audience in mind. Points system, dashboard with personalized statistics, and playful interface to transform brushing into a positive habit.

projects.title: Pokedex
projects.subtitle: Pokémon collection mini-site
projects.short_description: Explore and collect Pokémon through a dynamic interface.
projects.description: Training project on React and API consumption. This site dynamically displays Pokémon cards with their information, retrieved via a Web Service API.

projects.title: ClickIt!
projects.subtitle: Click mini-game with leaderboard
projects.short_description: Click as fast as you can and climb the leaderboard!
projects.description: Simple game where the goal is to click a button as many times as possible. Username system and scoreboard to compete with other players. This project helped me practice backend development, MongoDB, and DOM manipulation.

projects.title: LEO Design 3D
projects.subtitle: Photorealistic architectural renders
projects.short_description: Photorealistic 3D renders for architects and real estate developers.
projects.description: Alongside development, I create 3D visualizations for architects and real estate professionals. These renders help preview spaces, support decision-making, and provide accurate projections of projects before construction.
